priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield at all times.
Cast Primordial Storm if Maelstrom Weapon is at 9+ stacks or if the Primordial Storm buff is about to expire with at least 5 stacks.
Apply and maintain Flame Shock on your target.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities during Ascendance, Doom Winds, or if the fight is ending.
Cast Sundering if talented into Surging Elements or Feral Spirit.
Cast Crash Lightning if the Crash Lightning buff is missing or if talented into Storm Unleashed.
Cast Windstrike while Ascendance is active if you have any Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
Cast Tempest when you have 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Cast Lightning Bolt when you have 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Cast Stormstrike if it has nearly 2 charges or during Doom Winds.
Cast Lightning Bolt if you have 5 or more stacks of Maelstrom Weapon and nothing else is available.
